text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, pay attention to the tune. 
Keep it bouncy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Your expression's way too stiff~! Have 
more fun! Smile, smile! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the outdoor stage, I saw 
Duramente practicing her dancing. Vivlos 
and Verxina were there too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's an assignment for dance class. I 
noticed Duramente-san practicing all by 
herself, and I got a little curious.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's such a happy song, but you're dancing 
with a completely blank expression!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis said that won't pass the 
assignment and came to give advice. I'm 
just tagging along~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Verxina's dancing is perfect even during 
class. I'm so grateful to receive advice 
like this."
choice_data_list:
I see, so that's why they were coaching 
you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not good at expressing emotions 
to match the melody... This assignment 
piece in particular is difficult, so I'm 
struggling.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The assigned songs are a slow, mature song 
and an upbeat, cute song. Emotional 
expression is crucial for both.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... We should focus on one of 
them first. Which one do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Trainer, what do you think?
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should learn how to be more mature 
from Verxina
Let's have Vivlos teach us how to be cute

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, request accepted.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Duramente-san, try dancing. 
I'll point out the areas you need to fix.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Be conscious all the way to your 
fingertips. Express beauty gracefully, 
right through your fingers.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright, your expression! You're too 
tense. Relax your cheeks—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's smile. With the feeling of offering 
a warm smile to every single spectator...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, keep your expression steady until the 
very end, and sweep your gaze across the 
entire audience.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
OK! Hehe, that was a wonderfully calm and 
beautiful dance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see— Then let us continue like this. I 
want to get a feel for it today, even if 
just a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After receiving thorough instruction from 
Verxina, Duramente learned how to dance 
with a more mature flair.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, roger that! Since I was picked 
by name, I'll give it my all♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's bring out Duramente-san's cute and 
adorable side!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Understood—I shall do my utmost.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Duramente-saaan! Smile, smile☆

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A smile...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That looks suuuper good☆ Hold that winning 
pose♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, no~! It's a cute dance, remember! The 
finishing pose goes... like this!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Like this?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Kyaaah!! Duramente-san is so cuuute☆"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Cutest ever," is it? —Hm, deeper than it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Duramente continued to practice her 
cute dance moves, every passerby turned 
their heads to do a double-take.
